title: Affiliate Marketing for Beginners: A Free, Scam-Aware Starter Guide
summary: New to affiliate marketing? Skip the paid gurus. Get a free, step-by-step start with niche-narrowing, Amazon vs high-ticket programs, and a 30-day plan.
body_markdown:
## Amazon Associates vs High-Ticket Programs: The Honest Math


### How the Two Approaches Differ


Amazon Associates can suit product-focused content, but its commission varies by category. High-ticket offers focus on more expensive products or services, and programs in that category often pay $100 to $1,000 or more per sale. A larger potential commission does not make a sale easier: expensive offers need a clear audience fit, a credible explanation, and a buyer ready to commit.


Match the offer to your reader’s needs and your content’s ability to explain the purchase. Low-cost products can fit practical roundups and comparisons; higher-priced services need stronger buyer intent and enough detail to support a considered decision. A large commission is not useful if the offer does not suit your audience.


### Side-by-Side Commission Math


Compare potential commission using a stated rate, not the product price alone. It is a calculation example, not a claim about a particular program. Actual earnings depend on program terms, qualifying purchases, returns, and attribution.


### Networks and a Recurring-Commission Example


ShareASale, ClickBank, Impact, and CJ are[affiliate networks or platforms](https://www.reacherapp.com/blog/top-affiliate-marketing-platforms-compared-networks-software-and-apps-for-brands-and-creators) where publishers can explore offers and program terms. Each offer sets its own approval rules, commission structure, attribution window, and payout conditions. Read the details before building content around an offer; a familiar platform name does not guarantee a good fit for your readers.


The Reacher Affiliate Program states “Unlimited referrals and referral payouts for up to 12 months” and “20% commission per Reacher client referral, per month.” Review the program details and decide whether it fits your audience. This is a specific recurring-commission offer, not a universal benchmark for affiliate marketing for beginners.


### A Low-Barrier Option: TikTok Shop Affiliate Programs


[TikTok Shop affiliate](https://www.reacherapp.com/blog/tiktok-shop-affiliate-center-guide) programs connect product-focused creator content with products available for purchase through the platform. They can suit creators who prefer short video demonstrations over a review website or long-form tutorials. Eligibility, product availability, and commission terms vary, so check current requirements before planning content around an offer.


**Pros and cons**


#### Pros


- Product demonstrations can show use and context directly.
- Offers can match video topics and audience interests.


#### Cons


- Commission terms and eligibility depend on the program.
- Content reach and purchases are not guaranteed.


Choose the route that matches your content strengths and the reader’s buying decision. Compare the commission, attribution window, approval conditions, and payment rules before committing your publishing plan.
